draft.body:
Agents can pay. Agents can't borrow.

Siloed credit accounts force autonomous agents to run complex rebalancing math and burn gas across isolated pools.

Vanna’s Unified Margin Account offers a single aggregated credit line. Simpler policy execution — on testnet.
